name: My Fantastic Feline
source:
Hiya, cutie~! Have you ever wanted to live in a super yummy candy land with a kitty that loves you unconditionally?!

Now you can! Because Nox is here to make you super-duper happy and love you foreverrrr!!

I'll never leave you, my sweet li'l buddy! Come spend some time with me~!

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/my-fantastic-feline]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
哈喽，小可爱~！你有没有想过和一只无条件爱你的小猫一起生活在超级美味的糖果之地？

现在你可以了！因为Nox在这里让你超级快乐并永远爱你！！

我永远不会离开你，我亲爱的小伙伴！快来陪我度过一段时光吧~！

[来自[url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/my-fantastic-feline]Itch.io[/url]]
